bullets.title: The Biggest Little Farm
bullets.note: This film first caught my eye with its [beautiful trailer](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UfDTM4JxHl8). It has a 95% audience score [on Rotten Tomatoes](https://www.rottentomatoes.com/m/the_biggest_little_farm), and here’s the shortened description: “_The Biggest Little Farm_ chronicles the eight-year quest of John and Molly Chester as they trade city living for 200 acres of barren farmland and a dream to harvest in harmony with nature. Through dogged perseverance and embracing the opportunity provided by nature’s conflicts, the Chesters unlock and uncover a biodiverse design for living that exists far beyond their farm.” Their story made me reflect on life and “problems” differently.

bullets.title: Jon Batiste on the podcast
bullets.note: This podcast episode is one of my all-time favorites. It’s rare that I rewatch or re-listen to my own stuff, but this is an exception. The flow was magical, and the live music was mesmerizing. Jon brought bottled lightning, and I was lucky to be there. Trust me on this one. For those who don’t know Jon, he is a five-time Grammy Award-winning and Academy Award-winning singer, songwriter, and composer.
